business_summary: Shenzhen Fenda Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, production, and sales of consumer electronics devices and their components in Asia, Europe, America, Africa, Oceania, and China. It provides integrated solutions for intelligent hardware. The company also offers electroacoustic products, including wireless bluetooth speakers, smart voice speakers, soundbars, and portable energy storage speakers; and smart wearables, such as smart watches, smart bracelets, smart rings, and smart helmets. It also provides smart door locks and other new smart hardware; and health appliances comprising hair straighteners, curling irons, hair dryers, heating air combs, and straight hair combs. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Baoan Fenda Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Fenda Technology Co., Ltd. in 2010. Shenzhen Fenda Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
